workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: summarize_document tool schema does not list the allowed summary_type values
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(rag): list summarize_document's valid summary_type values in its schema. Target files: src/gaia/agents/tools/rag_tools.py, tests/unit/rag/test_summarize_document_schema.py, docs/spec/rag-tools-mixin.mdx. Before: `summarize_document` accepted only `brief`, `detailed` or `bullets` for `summary_type`, but its schema didn't say so. Unless the summarize skill was loaded, the model guessed values like `short` or `bullet_points`, the call failed, and it had to try again. This tool can run for up to 10 minutes. After: the schema lists ... (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/8624)

workarounds.symptom: Schedule store reads fail on Windows while a save is renaming the file
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(schedule): wait out a save's rename when reading the store on Windows. Target files: src/gaia/schedule/store.py, src/gaia/utils/file_lock.py, tests/unit/test_file_lock.py. On Windows, reading the schedule store while something else saved it could fail with "Permission denied": `gaia schedule list`/`show` could crash, and a recurring run that started at that instant was recorded as failed and skipped. It surfaced as a Windows unit failure on main. Reads now wait out the brief hold the way saves already do (up to 3 s), and a hold... (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/8596)

Fix: fix(security): let the agent read the images GAIA generated. Target files: src/gaia/agents/tools/shell_tools.py, src/gaia/config.py, src/gaia/sd/mixin.py. After generating an image, asking GAIA to describe or use it failed with "Access denied … No approval can grant it", because images are saved inside the protected `~/.gaia` folder. Now the agent can read the images it generated there; everything else in `~/.gaia` (config, keys, tokens, memory, logs) stays blocked, and nothing can be written into the images folder. (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/8478)

workarounds.symptom: A failing recurring schedule is recorded only in the daemon log; list/show still look healthy
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(schedule): record a failing recurring schedule on the schedule itself. Target files: src/gaia/cli.py, src/gaia/schedule/daemon.py, src/gaia/schedule/store.py. A recurring schedule whose runs fail now says so: `gaia schedule list` adds `failing=N`, and `gaia schedule show` prints how many runs in a row failed, when the latest did, its error, and the last run that succeeded. (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/8320)

workarounds.symptom: TUI and web UI call an unregistered cloud provider an old Lemonade
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(lemonade): report an unregistered cloud provider as a setup problem. Target files: src/gaia/ui/routers/providers.py, tui/internal/lemonade/cloud.go, tui/internal/lemonade/cloud_test.go. Classifies Lemonade's cloud 404 responses in the TUI gateway client, the TUI Lemonade client, and the web provider router, so an unregistered provider points at registration while a genuinely old server keeps the version hint. (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/8210)

workarounds.symptom: PowerShell guard reads a '\' string literal as the path C:\ and refuses with 'No approval can grant it'
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(shell): stop reading a '\' given to .Replace() as the drive root. Target files: src/gaia/agents/tools/shell_tools.py, tests/unit/test_shell_inline_script_paths.py. When the agent tidied paths in a PowerShell one-liner with `.Replace('\','/')`, GAIA refused the whole command as reaching the drive root, with "No approval can grant it", and the agent fell back to slower file tools. Now a separator a string method only searches for is read as text, so the command runs; a real root path such as `Get-ChildItem '\'` is still refused, ... (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/8102)

workarounds.symptom: CLI: gaia mcp engineering and gaia mcp code-index show their refusal as a traceback
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(mcp): gaia mcp engineering and code-index print their refusal, not a traceback. Target files: installer/core/smoke_test.py, src/gaia/mcp/servers/code_index_mcp.py, src/gaia/mcp/servers/engineering_mcp.py. `gaia mcp engineering` without `--developer-mode` and `gaia mcp code-index` from the home directory refuse to start for a stated reason. They now print that reason on stderr and exit 1, with no traceback. (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/7536)

workarounds.symptom: 'gaia schedule add' with a taken name prints a Python traceback
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): print one line when gaia schedule add reuses a name. Target files: src/gaia/cli.py, tests/unit/cli/test_cli_schedule.py. `gaia schedule add` with a name that's already taken now prints one error line and exits 1, instead of crashing with a Python traceback. (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/8126)

workarounds.symptom: CLI says 'Lemonade server is not installed ... run gaia init' when GAIA's own Lemonade is installed and only the URL is
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(llm): stop calling a custom Lemonade URL "not installed". Target files: src/gaia/llm/lemonade_manager.py, tests/unit/cli/test_model_download_exit_code.py, tests/unit/test_lemonade_not_running_remedy.py. When you point GAIA at your own model server (`LEMONADE_BASE_URL`, or a saved external server) and nothing answers there, commands like `gaia download --list` said Lemonade was "not installed" and told you to run `gaia init`. That's false when GAIA's own Lemonade is installed, and `gaia init` can't fix an unreachable URL anyway.... (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/8066)

workarounds.symptom: Fedora 44: setup cannot connect a cloud model or download one (SSL CA error)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(linux): name a missing CA file instead of blaming the key. Target files: src/gaia/llm/lemonade_client.py, src/gaia/llm/lemonade_embedded.py, src/gaia/llm/lemonade_tls.py. On a Fedora 44 PC that has not installed updates, setup's cloud step said "Fireworks AI did not accept that key" for a valid key, and model downloads failed with a bare CURL error. The cause is a missing system certificate file that GAIA's model server needs for HTTPS. GAIA now names that cause in setup and on downloads and says to install the system's updates... (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/7255)

workarounds.symptom: gaia talk cannot start in the installed build
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(installer): bundle the MCP, talk and notification extras in gaia. Target files: installer/core/freeze.py, installer/core/smoke_test.py, setup.py. In the `gaia` that the installers ship, `gaia mcp serve`, `gaia mcp tui` and `gaia mcp code-index` died on a missing `mcp` module, `gaia talk` stopped on a missing audio library and offered a pip command the program cannot run, and a Windows schedule notification was a message box waiting for a click. The build carried only the Agent UI's dependencies. It now carries all three, refuse... (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/7231)

workarounds.symptom: CI: a Launchpad API timeout is reported as "a reason other than a Launchpad outage"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(installer): name a Launchpad API timeout as an outage. Target files: src/gaia/installer/lemonade_installer.py, tests/unit/test_init_command.py. When Launchpad's API stops answering, the Linux CLI check now says so. It used to say the PPA step failed "for a reason other than a Launchpad outage", which sent authors looking for a bug in their own PR: on 2026-11-11, `main` and several PRs failed this way for hours. A timeout is blamed on Launchpad only when apt reached other repositories, so an offline machine isn't misread as an o... (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/7163)

workarounds.symptom: ci: Skill Audit and label fail closed on GitHub App rate limit, faking red on unrelated PRs
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(ci): fail the skill audit gate when the audit never ran. Target files: .github/workflows/skill_audit.yml, tests/unit/test_skill_audit_workflow_contract.py. The skill audit gate now reports, as a distinct infrastructure failure, that its audit never ran, instead of reading the missing counts as zero and printing "Skill audit passed." It also runs after an upstream step fails, which is what makes that report reachable at all. A successful audit with violations still fails with the existing policy errors. (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/6990)
